scripts.build: npm run preprocess && bundle exec jekyll build ${BASEURL:+--baseurl $BASEURL} && npm run index
scripts.build:quick: npm run preprocess && bundle exec jekyll build ${BASEURL:+--baseurl $BASEURL}
scripts.serve:indexed: npm run build && bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0 --skip-initial-build
scripts.serve:quick: npm run build:quick && npm run serve
